label: Self-determined widths
subgoals: Assign each leaf its declared width
Combine widths at each operator with max, sum or product as the rule says
Work bottom up to the root of the expression

label: Comparisons, reductions, shifts and conditionals
subgoals: Give comparisons and reductions a width of 1 bit
Keep the left operand's width for shifts
Take the wider arm for a conditional and ignore its condition

label: Context-determined evaluation
subgoals: Find the widest of the operands and the assignment target
Evaluate context-determined operands at that width
Stop propagation at concatenations, which are self-determined
